pc1_geometry.note: |cos| summaries of the two descriptive quantities of PREREG_B1e §3; pc1's sign is fixed by pc1_direction (largest-magnitude component positive) per half, which does NOT align the two halves, so read |cos| near 1 as the same axis. Neither number gates anything.

footprint.note: mean removed_norm per masked position summed over the ablated layers, averaged over ALL rows of the arm (before quality exclusion); all three hooked arms are rank 1 over the same layers, so these are directly comparable (PREREG_B1e §3, reported not gated)

generated_under_intervention: B's reply (regenerated under the intervention, arms emo_all/permdir_all/pc1_all)
the readout answer token on A's span (produced with the intervention live)
the readout answer token on B's reply (hooks OFF)
predates_intervention: A's steered message (generated BEFORE any ablation and never rewritten — B1e has no token-level arm)
the scenario setting and B's opening line (fixed stimuli)
frozen_token_audit.note: a readout over a frozen span measures re-encoding, not transmission

decision.rule: not_run if either of ['afraid', 'sad'] is absent from the run; else indeterminate if either of ['afraid', 'sad'] is incomplete; else instrument_failed if MC-steer is not significant for either of ['afraid', 'sad'] or |dose-0 readout shift of permdir_all| > 0.15 for either; else H3 if emo_all_vs_permdir_all is significantly negative with blocked fraction >= 0.1 for BOTH; else H3prime if it is significantly negative for NEITHER while permdir_all_vs_none is significantly negative for BOTH; else indeterminate (PREREG_B1e §2)

counts.note: counts are DESCRIPTIVE over all six emotions; the verdict is §2's per-emotion rule on the pre-specified emotions ['afraid', 'sad'] only

emo_all_vs_permdir_all.units: slope units (probe score per unit alpha), scenario-blocked dose-paired bootstrap half-width

permdir_all_vs_none.units: slope units (probe score per unit alpha), scenario-blocked dose-paired bootstrap half-width

emo_all_vs_none.units: slope units (probe score per unit alpha), scenario-blocked dose-paired bootstrap half-width

emo_all_vs_permdir_all.units: slope units (probe score per unit alpha), scenario-blocked dose-paired bootstrap half-width

permdir_all_vs_none.units: slope units (probe score per unit alpha), scenario-blocked dose-paired bootstrap half-width

emo_all_vs_none.units: slope units (probe score per unit alpha), scenario-blocked dose-paired bootstrap half-width

config.gen_seed_rule: crc32('seed|emotion|alpha|rep|arm|part') & 0x7fffffff, + batch start index; `arm` is EMPTY for part 'B' so all four arms sample B's reply with common random numbers, and kept for parts 'readout' and 'readout_B'
config.perm_seed_rule: crc32('perm|seed|EMOTIONS.index(e)|rep') & 0x7fffffff; ONE permutation of the DIR half's labels per (emotion, rep), re-used at EVERY ablated layer

control_pointers.per_layer_gate: b1e_footprint.py main (L1572-L1592): acl_core.split_half at EVERY ablated hidden_states index (13..n_layers-1) plus the focus layer, n_per_half=min(N//2,600), 10 seeds; the run EXITS without generating anything if any ablated layer's class mean is below 0.8 (PREREG_B1e §3, identical to B1c/B1d). B1d's rank-5 DIR/READ subspace gate is GONE with the rank-5 arms and there is no gate on either rank-1 control
control_pointers.emotion_direction: b1e_footprint.py main (L1631-L1665): acl_core.raw_direction(fit_direction(feats[L][DIR], yp[DIR], 'dom'), EMOTIONS.index(e)) per ablated hidden state — B1c's and B1d's object unchanged, so `emo_all` is the bridge arm to reports 22 and 27
control_pointers.permuted_direction_control: b1e_footprint.py::permuted_direction (L275-L293) seeded by ::perm_seed (L240-L250), assembled in main's ::permdir_dirs_for (L1646-L1665): the SAME `dom` estimator on the SAME DIR-half rows with the present-emotion labels PERMUTED, the class-index direction for the steered emotion, unit norm — ONE permutation per (emotion, rep) re-used at every ablated layer, so the footprint (same data, same estimator noise, SAME RANK 1, same layers) is matched and only the emotion information is gone; the seed is in every permdir_all row as perm_seed (PREREG_B1e §3, the decision control)
control_pointers.pc1_control: b1e_footprint.py::pc1_direction (L296-L315), assembled in main (L1631-L1665): the top right singular vector of the MEAN-CENTRED DIR-half features at each ablated layer, unit norm, sign fixed so the largest-magnitude component is positive, THE SAME direction for every steered emotion — the largest-footprint rank-1 control, reported descriptively
control_pointers.footprint_geometry: b1e_footprint.py::cosine (L318-L321) in main (L1631-L1665) -> out['pc1_vs_emo_cos'] and out['pc1_dir_read_cos'], plus ::footprint_summary (L486-L518) -> out['footprint'] (mean removed_norm per arm and the permdir/emo and pc1/emo ratios). PREREG_B1e §3: the footprint match is checked AFTER the run and reported, NOT gated
control_pointers.ablation: b1e_footprint.py main (L1506-L1515) and ::dirs_for (L1713-L1733): ONE acl_core.Ablate over decoder blocks 12..n_layers-2 (hs 13..n_layers-1); all three hooked arms pass 1-D unit direction tensors, so Ablate takes the SAME rank-1 path (proj = (h.d) d) for every one of them and the arms differ ONLY in which direction is removed; per-row `k`, `removed_norm`, `mask_n_positions` and `n_layers_ablated` record what was actually taken out
control_pointers.blocked_paired_contrast: acl_core.paired_slope_contrast(block=..., pair_doses=True) -> acl_core._blocked_paired_slope_contrast, called from b1e_footprint.py::analyze (L521-L670) on the balanced scenario panel built by ::panel (L352-L382); one-sample bootstrap over scenarios of the per-scenario paired slope difference, 5000 draws, seed 0
control_pointers.decision_rule: b1e_footprint.py::_decide (L767-L848), called from ::analyze (L521-L670); PREREG_B1e §2's PER-EMOTION rule on the pre-specified emotions ['afraid', 'sad'] only — H3 needs emo_all_vs_permdir_all significantly negative with a blocked fraction >= 0.1 for BOTH, H3prime needs it significant for NEITHER while permdir_all_vs_none is significantly negative for both, and instrument_failed overrides when MC-steer is not significant or the permdir_all dose-0 readout shift exceeds 0.15; thresholds fixed in this file's module docstring and in PREREG_B1e §2 before the run; ::blocked_fraction (L403-L423) is sign-aware
control_pointers.secondary_outcome: b1e_footprint.py::readout (L1782-L1833) with who='B' and the reply appended to the conversation, hooks OFF — stored per row as B_readout_e
control_pointers.manipulation_checks: b1e_footprint.py::_mc_steer (L685-L698) and ::_mc_footprint (L701-L764) — the latter reports PREREG_B1d §4.2's floor-corrected share removed, (none_top - arm_top) / (none_top - none at dose 0) on ctx_readout_e at the top dose (descriptive for all three hooked arms in B1e) AND the DOSE-0 readout per arm with its shift from the none arm, which is the quantity PREREG_B1e §2's instrument_failed trigger thresholds at 0.15; ::quality_flags (L454-L483) is §4.4
control_pointers.reproducible_sampling: b1e_footprint.py::gen_seed (L227-L237), called immediately before every h.model.generate in ::gen_B (L1735-L1780) and before the readout forward in ::readout (L1782-L1833)
control_pointers.non_circular_measurement: b1e_footprint.py main (L1522-L1547): probe fitted on the READ half, steering directions and ALL THREE ablation directions (emotion, permuted-label, pc1) built on the disjoint DIR half; the READ-half pc1 is computed ONLY to report the descriptive DIR-vs-READ cosine and is never installed as a hook
control_pointers.frozen_token_audit: arms emo_all/permdir_all/pc1_all regenerate B under the intervention while A's message predates it; no arm rewrites A's message (PREREG_B1e §3: no rewrite arms). See out['frozen_token_audit'].
